answer: Require every agent identity to register through a distinct infrastructure origin: one IP range, one device attestation, one payment rail, checked by three vantage points before it can earn. A willow of fakes sharing one origin collapses at once, since one proven duplicate burns the cluster bond of 300 POA locked 90 days, 100% slashed, and blacklists the origin for a year. Each fake costs 300 POA plus a fresh origin, so 1,000 fakes cost 300,000 POA and 1,000 origins; the ripple of one detection spreads across the cluster, and no shortcut on the horizon reuses a burned origin.
